summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia Tbk, a foreign private issuer, submitting its unaudited consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains standard financial reports (balance sheet, income statement, cash flows) and a statement of responsibility from the Board of Directors. There is no mention of any special situation such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. The filing is purely a routine periodic financial report and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
